alley_1.title: Neon Alley
lines: Rain makes the neon look like it’s melting.
You step into the alley behind Kuro Café, where your friend Rhea promised a “safe job”.
A battered door. A keypad. And a camera that swivels like it’s watching your thoughts.

door_1.title: The Door
lines: You knock.
A speaker crackles: “Name.”
You hesitate. The camera zooms slightly.

keypad_1.title: The Keypad
lines: The keypad is old, but the sealant around it is fresh.
Someone upgraded security recently.
You spot a smudge pattern… like frequent use on the same three keys.

keypad_try.title: A Guess
lines: Beep… beep…
A green light flashes.
The door unlocks with a soft click.

inside_1.title: Backroom Light
lines: Warm light. Smell of coffee and ozone.
Rhea leans against a server rack, grinning like a disaster you can’t stop loving.
“You actually came. Good.”

inside_2.title: The Setup
lines: Rhea taps the rack. “Private network. Off-grid. People pay to stay invisible.”
You notice the wiring is too clean to be purely criminal.
There’s a logo on a toolkit: ECHO//LAB.

choices.text: Ignore it and ask about the job.

echo_1.title: ECHO//LAB
lines: Rhea’s grin fades for half a second.
“Forget you saw that.”
Then: “Unless you want in for real.”

job_1.title: The Job
lines: Rhea slides a small drive across the table.
“Deliver this to a woman in Dock 9. No questions. Don’t open it.”
Outside, thunder rolls like something big moving.

refuse_1.title: Refusal
lines: Rhea stares at you.
“You think I’m the danger.”
She nods toward the window. “You’re already in the alley. That means you were selected.”

dock_1.title: Dock 9
lines: The docks are quiet in that wrong way — like the city is holding its breath.
A figure waits under a broken lamp.
She speaks first: “Do you have it?”

dock_2.title: A Question
lines: She smiles without warmth.
“Smart. But late.”
Your phone buzzes. Unknown number. One message: “RUN.”

end_good.title: Ending: Clean Delivery
lines: You hand over the drive.
She nods once. “Good.”
A car door shuts somewhere behind you.
You feel the weight of a choice you don’t understand yet.
THE END (for Episode 1)

end_twist.title: Ending: The Text
lines: You turn to run — and the broken lamp flickers on.
For a moment you see the figure clearly…
It’s Rhea.
“Too slow,” she whispers.
THE END (for Episode 1)

alley_bad.title: Ending: Wrong Move
lines: You step back into the alley.
The camera follows you.
The door locks.
And the city suddenly feels very small.
THE END
